root_cause.text: The queue limit check in the `netem_enqueue` function incorrectly validates the queue size using `q->t_len` (which only tracks packets in the internal `tfifo`) instead of `sch->q.qlen`, failing to account for reordered packets placed in `sch->q` and allowing the total queue occupancy to exceed `sch->limit`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff replaces the check `if (unlikely(q->t_len >= sch->limit))` with `if (unlikely(sch->q.qlen >= sch->limit))` in `net/sched/sch_netem.c`, and the commit message states that "Packets placed in sch->q by the reorder path (__qdisc_enqueue_head) are not counted, allowing the total queue occupancy to exceed sch->limit under reordering."
